name: VisionGlobal Corporation
summary: VisionGlobal Corporation, an emerging enterprise, is poised to launch high-speed wireless telecommunication services for its clientele. Its operational network will integrate both proprietary innovations and readily available market components. This network is designed to employ 16-point Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (16-QAM) technology, enabling one-way data transfer speeds of up to 36 megabits per second. The company will introduce its offerings to the market under the brand name 'VisionZOOM'. Initially, VisionGlobal intends to concentrate solely on providing internet access and data networking solutions. However, it also plans to cultivate alliances with various strategic partners to broaden its service portfolio to include richer voice, video, and data content. Established in 1986, the corporation is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
